home.question: Do you offer a free trial
home.answer: Yes, 14 days to put it through its paces in real conditions, no credit card needed upfront. You activate, you measure, you decide.

home.question: Will my customers actually play? They aren't gamers.
home.answer: That's exactly the point. The game isn't for gamers, it's for everyone. A spinning wheel speaks to your grandma just as much as a 14-year-old. 89% of scans lead to a game launched.

home.question: Can I set a minimum purchase to redeem prizes?
home.answer: Yes, you set a single threshold across all your prizes. Whether it's $0, $5, or $10, you define the minimum order needed for a customer to walk away with their prize.

home.question: Can I brand the game with my store's colors?
home.answer: It's our signature move. 13 starting templates, 100% custom color palette, your logo, your typography, your illustrations. Your customers play at your place, not at BoumRank's.

home.question: Who are you, really? French startup? Offshore team?
home.answer: 100% French team, based in Marseille, part of the Pépite Aix-Marseille University program. French support, French billing, founders reachable on WhatsApp. No hotline in Bangalore.

home.question: I'm terrible with tech. Can I really do this?
home.answer: Yes, no sweat. Setup takes 5 minutes flat: pick your game from a list, drop in your logo, click 'Activate'. We email you the printable QR code. If you can post on Instagram, you can use BoumRank.

hero.title: Two friends, one obsession:
hero.titleGradient: let merchants focus on what they love
hero.subtitle: BoumRank was born from a simple observation. Here's our story.

story.title: You're a merchant, not a social media manager
story.p1: You open at 7am. You close at 10pm. In between, you cook, cut, style, and welcome everyone who walks in. You give everything to your craft. Google rankings, customer reviews, follow-ups, loyalty programs — you know they matter. But you don't have the time, the energy, or the desire to become a digital marketing expert.
story.p2: Meanwhile, competitors who've figured out these tools are taking your spot on Google.

painPoints.title: Asking for a review is awkward
painPoints.body: You hesitate to do it in person. It feels pushy.

painPoints.title: Local SEO is a black box
painPoints.body: Too many tools, too much jargon, never enough time to actually dig in.

painPoints.title: Marketing eats your day
painPoints.body: Every hour you spend automating is an hour you're not with your customers.

team.title: We found
team.quote: We watched our friends, our family — merchants we loved — struggle every day to get noticed. We knew there had to be a better way. We looked for it. We found it.
team.p: We tested it first with family — Liam's mom, Maui's brother — before offering it to anyone else. We didn't have the right to waste their time. Today, it works. And we want to bring it to every merchant who deserves to be taken care of.

items.question: What happens if I cancel before my commitment ends?
items.answer: On the 6-month and annual plans, you commit to the full term. Early cancellation means paying out the remaining months. On the month-to-month plan (€79/mo), you can cancel in one click, whenever you want, no penalty.

items.question: How does renewal work at the end of my term?
items.answer: Your subscription renews automatically at the same rate. Before each renewal date, we reach out to review your results and confirm (or adjust) your plan. No surprises. No gotchas.

items.question: Does the 14-day free trial apply to all three plans?
items.answer: Yes — all three plans start with a 14-day free trial, no credit card required at signup. Every feature unlocked, no scan limits. On day 14, you choose your plan (or you walk away, no hard feelings).

items.question: Can I switch plans mid-way through?
items.answer: Upgrading to a longer commitment (lower price) is instant, anytime. Downgrading to a shorter commitment takes effect at the end of your current billing cycle. One click from your dashboard.

items.question: Are all features really included, even on the €79/mo plan?
items.answer: Yes. All 3 games, 100% custom branding, the Performance dashboard, sequential campaigns, CSV export, Zapier, priority support: everything is unlocked from day one, regardless of plan. The only difference between plans is the commitment length and the price.

items.question: How do payments and invoicing work?
items.answer: Monthly recurring billing via Stripe (PCI-DSS Level 1). A PDF invoice is generated each month, downloadable from your dashboard. EU hosting, GDPR-compliant, zero data reselling. First charge hits at the end of your 14-day trial.
